target.title: Reject nonfinite OpenAI cost values
target.body:
## Summary

- reject non-finite numeric and numeric-string values in OpenAI Admin API cost responses
- prevent `NaN`/infinity from contaminating cost totals and breaking JSON output
- preserve existing support for valid numeric strings
- add focused coverage for `"NaN"`, `"Infinity"`, and overflowing `"1e309"`

## After-fix behavior proof

The freshly built production cost parser was run with three malformed API values. Each now fails at the `costs` decode boundary instead of producing a non-finite `costUSD` value:

```text
OpenAIAPIUsageFetcherTests
  value → "NaN" passed
  value → "Infinity" passed
  value → "1e309" passed
  12 tests passed
```

This protects the downstream `OpenAIAPIUsageSnapshot` and CLI JSON encoder, which cannot represent `NaN` or infinity in valid JSON.

A live Admin API request is not used because repository policy requires fixture/stub validation for parser behavior unless a real provider probe is explicitly requested.

## Testing

- `swift test --disable-sandbox --filter OpenAIAPIUsageFetcherTests` (12 passed)
- `make check` (0 formatting or lint violations)
- `make test` (the unrelated Claude credential shard exceeded its 180-second group timeout; its `ClaudeDirectUsageFallbackTests` retry passed, then the credential-storage retry stalled in this sandbox; stopped without any failure in the changed OpenAI suite)
